reviews.text: I've recently been taking my Toy Poodle for her weekly bath at this grooming salon, and I must say that Ludovica clearly takes great care of her, so much so that when we go, the little dog can't wait to be in her arms!

Third experience, certainly the last.

The worst part was finding our 2.2 kg Yorkshire Terrier, already very fearful, alone on a counter, tied to the wall and visibly shaking, while the owner was outside. We arrived precisely at 7:00 PM, the time we had been given for collection.

The work was also decidedly disappointing: whiskers trimmed despite our express request not to have them, uneven fur, uneven ears, chest and paws practically unkempt, and untrimmed nails.

€35 for a barely noticeable result and instructions not followed.

To top off the experience, a lack of empathy, poor communication, and unwelcoming attitude, something we've already encountered on previous occasions.

We won't be returning.

Following the owner's response, since I can't respond directly, this is what I think of her response, which, among other things, avoided exactly what it shouldn't have done:

The response confirms what we perceived: the problem was not addressed. Our Yorkshire Terrier is groomed every month, and you performed the three previous groomings. Talking about a very matted coat and a job done for free isn't convincing, considering we pay €35-40 each time, and grooming is included in the service. There was no misunderstanding: we specifically asked for his whiskers not to be trimmed, but they were trimmed, and now the fur is falling even further in front of his eyes. Furthermore, his nails were untrimmed, his private parts were unkempt, his chest was left long, and his hair was cut unevenly. We arrived at the time you indicated and found a small dog weighing less than two and a half kilos, fearful and trembling, tied up alone on the bench. For us, the facts are what matter: the outcome and the condition in which we found our dog. For this reason, we won't be returning.

If you're looking for professionalism, knowledge, and respect for animals, skill, and a place where your dog can feel at ease...then you've found the right place!
Ludovica is professional and knows exactly what cuts and treatments are right for every skin type and dog. I regularly take my Westie (who's known to have a lot of dermatitis and allergy issues) and with her products and her touch, he's always returned healthy and flawless, and most importantly, without any aftercare issues! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Working with small, defenseless, and often frightened animals shouldn't be considered simply a job: it requires patience, sensitivity, empathy, and above all, love for animals.

A puppy can't speak, can't explain that it's afraid or uncomfortable: it relies completely on the person in whose care it's placed. For this very reason, those who choose this profession should also pay particular attention to its emotional well-being, not simply limit themselves to washing or cutting its fur.

If you lack the patience needed to gently treat such vulnerable animals, perhaps it's time to ask yourself if this is really the right profession for you.

Because respect for the animal entrusted to you comes before the quality of the grooming.
